about: Hello! I’m a Backend Developer with 4 years of experience, driven by a passion for problem-solving and a keen attention to detail. My strengths lie in rapidly debugging issues, finding efficient workarounds, and delivering high-quality solutions. Having worked in both remote and onsite environments, I am comfortable working independently while also seeking guidance from experts when needed. I’ve gained hands-on experience with cloud services like AWS, Oracle JDE, and ServiceNow.
Outside of work, I enjoy traveling, photography, and discovering new foods. I love capturing moments through my camera and always look for the next great meal to try!
